highlights.title: Amazon Offers Early Savings on 2026 Mac Mini, Plus Record Low on AirTag 2

Mac Mini Pre-Orders

Where can I find the original deal? Right here

Amazon this week introduced the first cash discounts on Apple's brand new Mac mini, with discounts including two of the M6 models as well as the M5 Pro model. All of these deals are pre-order discounts on the 2026 Mac mini, which officially launches on September 22.

AirTag 2

Apple's AirTag 2 is on sale for $79.99 this week on Amazon, down from $99.00. This deal is on the 4-Pack of the AirTag 2, and it's a new record low price for the accessory, beating the previous low by about $9.

highlights.title: Microsoft-backed AI data center faces backlash over 62 unpermitted gas turbines and 1.5M-gallon LNG tank — issues with $19.4B facility range from illegal construction to noise pollution
highlights.description: The community surrounding the DataOne data center in Vineland, New Jersey, are complaining about the Microsoft-linked project.
